name: sg_senders_create
description: Create a new sender identity. A verification email is sent to the from address; the sender cannot be used until verified. (POST /v3/senders)

nickname.description: A nickname for the sender identity. Not used for sending; shown in the UI for reference.

from_email.description: The email address that will appear in the from field of sent messages.

from_name.description: The name that will appear alongside the from email address.

reply_to.description: The email address to which replies will be sent.

address.description: The physical address of the sender identity, required for CAN-SPAM compliance.

city.description: The city of the sender identity.

country.description: The country of the sender identity.
